offers.name: White-label Lead-Path Revenue Leak Evidence Sprint
offers.buyer: A US or otherwise legally approved agency serving HVAC, plumbing, or electrical businesses
offers.trigger: The agency needs independent, reproducible evidence that a downstream client's public lead path loses, delays, or obscures qualified demand.
offers.promise: Within five business days of complete inputs, deliver a partner-brandable evidence pack showing the tested lead path, reproducible findings, severity, evidence references, remediation backlog, and an explicit list of what could not be verified.

included: up to five agency-authorized synthetic scenarios when written authorization and safe test data exist
response-time evidence only when the buyer supplies receipts or authorizes a controlled test
excluded: submitting forms without explicit written scope and test identity
CRM, field-service, DNS, website, or production-system writes
legal, tax, security, accessibility, or revenue guarantees
claiming lost or recovered revenue without buyer-origin transaction evidence

inputsRequired: systems explicitly in and out of bounds
acceptanceCriteria: Every finding has a timestamp, evidence reference, severity, scope boundary, and reproduction status.
Contradictory observations are preserved rather than averaged away.
No claimed revenue amount appears without buyer-origin transaction evidence.
The pack names untested and unverifiable surfaces.
The buyer explicitly accepts or rejects the exact versioned delivery.

deliverySla.startsWhen: Cleared payment and all required inputs are present.

pricingHypothesis.rule: Do not change the price mid-canary; record acceptance, negotiation, or rejection as external evidence.

distributionRecipe.initialAudienceHypothesis: Agencies publicly demonstrating home-service specialization and at least three downstream client examples.
distributionRecipe.contactRule: No recipient is contacted until jurisdiction, public-contact provenance, suppression, provider policy, sender health, physical-address, unsubscribe, and owner authority gates all pass.
distributionRecipe.partnerCompoundingLoop: One agency can sponsor multiple downstream sprints; each accepted pack can become a case-specific proof artifact only with buyer permission.

recurringGraduation.allowedAfter: At least three paid, accepted sprints with a repeatable common scope and evidence that buyers value monitoring.
recurringGraduation.notAllowedBefore: Repeated paid demand and measured positive contribution.

killConditions: No qualified buyer conversation in the bounded initial audience.
No paid pilot after five qualified conversations.
Founder-minute ceiling is exceeded and the cause is not reusable.
Delivery requires consequential production actions outside the signed scope.

offers.name: AI Agent Acceptance Evidence Sprint
offers.buyer: An AI implementation agency or software team preparing a customer-facing agent release
offers.trigger: The buyer needs independent evidence that a versioned agent follows procedures, reaches expected final states, escalates correctly, and avoids unauthorized extra actions.
offers.promise: Within five business days of receiving a safe sandbox and expected outcomes, execute a bounded scenario pack and deliver repeat-run acceptance evidence, failures, traces, and a prioritized repair backlog.

included: up to three repeated runs per scenario when nondeterminism is material
excluded: live financial, account, identity, or irreversible actions
customer acceptance inferred from internal scores

acceptanceCriteria: Every scenario has an expected state, observed state, pass/fail/blocked outcome, trace reference, and run count.
No production or real-customer effect occurs.
Unexpected extra actions fail the scenario.
Nondeterministic results are reported as distributions, not one cherry-picked pass.
The buyer explicitly accepts or rejects the exact delivery.

deliverySla.startsWhen: Cleared payment, safe sandbox, and complete scenario contract are present.

distributionRecipe.activationCondition: Primary canary reaches a kill threshold, or a qualified buyer supplies the required sandbox and requests paid independent acceptance evidence.
